en.title: Jesus Meets His Mother
en.meditation:
Consider the meeting of the Son and the Mother, which took place on this journey. Jesus and Mary looked at each other, and their looks became as so many arrows to wound those hearts which loved each other so tenderly.

My most loving Jesus, by the sorrow Thou didst experience in this meeting, grant me the grace of a truly devoted love for Thy most holy Mother. And thou, my Queen, who wast overwhelmed with sorrow, obtain for me by thy intercession a continual and tender remembrance of the Passion of thy Son. I love Thee, Jesus my love; I repent of ever having offended Thee. Never permit me to offend Thee again. Grant that I may love Thee always; and then do with me what Thou wilt.
en.versicle: We adore Thee, O Christ, and we bless Thee.
en.response: Because by Thy holy Cross, Thou hast redeemed the world.
en.source: eCatholic2000.com, "The Way of the Cross" by St. Alphonsus de Liguori, https://www.ecatholic2000.com/liguori/stations/cross.shtml, retrieved 2026-08-23

fr.title: Jésus rencontre sa mère affligée
fr.meditation:
Considérons la rencontre du Fils et de la Mère sur le chemin douloureux. Jésus et Marie se regardent, et leurs regards sont comme autant de traits qui percent réciproquement leurs cœurs brûlants d’un mutuel amour.

Très aimant Jésus, par la peine que vous avez ressentie, dans cette rencontre, accordez-moi la grâce d’être un vrai serviteur de votre très Sainte Mère, et d’avoir en Elle une grande confiance.
fr.versicle: Nous t’adorons, ô Christ, et nous te bénissons,
fr.response: parce que tu as racheté le monde par ta sainte Croix.
fr.source: spiritualite-chretienne.com, "Chemin de Croix avec les meditations de St Alphonse de Liguori" (site now defunct/repurposed; archived via Wayback Machine, e.g. https://web.archive.org/web/20200221112546/http://www.spiritualite-chretienne.com/croix/stat-c01.html), retrieved 2026-08-23 -- provisional pending AELF licence, per content/README.md (meditation); Diocese de Saint-Etienne (diocese-saintetienne.fr), "Chemin de Croix", https://www.diocese-saintetienne.fr/wp-content/uploads/2020/04/Chemin-de-croix.pdf, retrieved 2026-08-23 -- provisional pending AELF licence, per content/README.md (versicle/response)
